name: Platform API requests through the token handler
summary: Call ADSP platform services as the signed-in user from the preview, without holding a token in the code.
notes: In Builder preview the targets are form-service (/form/v1/...) and file-service (/file/v1/...); there are no others, so use mock data and say so for any other service
The builder signs the user in before the preview loads; do not add sign in code, and never put access tokens, secrets or API keys in the code
Always use apiFetch, not raw fetch: it adds the CSRF header needed for requests other than GET
401 means the session ended (reload the builder); 403 means the user's role does not allow the request
Requests run as the builder's user in their tenant: prefer reads and do not change data unless the user asked
A deployed app needs its own token handler client, a /token-handler proxy and a sign in; see the token handler documentation
